e.title: Rasa Insurance Starterpack
e.summary: Rasa 官方美国保险客服对话 AI 起步包：保险业务对话助手
e.body:
starterpack-insurance-en 是 Rasa（对话式 AI 框架）官方为美国保险用例提供的起步包：预训练的保险客服对话助手（保单查询、理赔流程引导等）——对话式 AI 在保险客服的标准实现。对 RIAA：保险对话式 AI 的官方工程起点。与 [[cloudco-insurance]]（IBM 聊天机器人）、[[insurance-voice-qwen]]（语音）互补。关联 [[claimpilot-harness]]、[[actuarial-skills]]。

e.summary_en: Official Rasa starter pack for US insurance: conversational AI insurance customer-service assistant
e.summary_hk: Rasa 官方美國保險客服對話 AI 起步包：保險業務對話助手
e.body_en:
starterpack-insurance-en is Rasa's official starter pack for a US insurance use case: a prebuilt insurance customer-service conversational assistant (policy queries, claims-process guidance) — the standard implementation of conversational AI for insurance customer service. For RIAA: the official engineering starting point for insurance conversational AI. Complements [[cloudco-insurance]] (IBM chatbot) and [[insurance-voice-qwen]] (voice). Related: [[claimpilot-harness]], [[actuarial-skills]].
